name: Aigami Runa
source:
A quiet girl that got involved in the Battle Royal just a week after transferring classes. She has yet to talk much with anyone other than her friend Marin. [spoiler]In truth, she is the winner of the previous Battle Royal.

Her provided weapon is a fork.[/spoiler]
